description: Delay line with feedback, a tone control and a balance between dry and delayed signal

params.text: Sets the delay time from 1ms to 10 seconds; with a clock patched it multiplies or divides the clock period instead
Sets how much of the filtered delayed signal is fed back into the delay line, for repeated taps
Filters the delayed signal: lowpass below the middle of its travel, highpass above it
Sets the balance of dry and delayed signal sent to the MIX output
Scales the TIME input from -100% to 100%; at 100% each volt halves the delay time
Scales the FDBK input from -100% to 100%, so the modulation can be made shallow or reversed
Scales the TONE input from -100% to 100%, so the modulation can be made shallow or reversed
Scales the MIX input from -100% to 100%, so the modulation can be made shallow or reversed

inputs.text: Moves the delay time by an amount set by the TIME knob
Moves the feedback by an amount set by the FDBK knob
Moves the tone by an amount set by the TONE knob
Moves the dry and delayed balance by an amount set by the MIX knob
A clock patched here sets the delay time, which the TIME knob then multiplies or divides

outputs.text: Dry and delayed signal together, in the balance set by the MIX knob
The delayed signal on its own, with none of the dry signal

notes: the delay line is monophonic; the channels of a polyphonic input are added together before they are delayed

inputs.5: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
